thread:
Rachel L: quick ask from BankEdge — they want a short POC to validate our streaming SDK behind their corporate proxy + SAML IdP. They also want a one-page example in Go, recommendations for batching to hit low p95 latency, and a reserved-capacity pricing ballpark for ~200 qps. Can someone pick this up?

Matt G: I got SSO/handshake. Short answer: we support OIDC and SAML (SP-initiated or IdP-initiated). For corporate proxies we prefer short-lived tokens + backend exchange to avoid long-lived creds in clients. If they want full SP metadata exchange (EntityID, ACS), we can do it; onboarding is slower but straightforward. @Rachel L can you share IdP metadata and proxy details? :point_down:

Sam P: Batching notes: if they need sub-100ms p95, try continuous batching with max_batch_latency=8ms and max_batch_size=32 for 4k-8k token workloads. If they prioritize cost, bump to max_batch_latency=25ms and max_batch_size=128 — measured ~15-22% token-cost savings on similar workloads. Recommend enabling KV prefix caching for repeated prompts. I can post a mini bench with numbers in the runbook.

Rachel L: IdP is Okta, SP-initiated. Proxy is corporate outbound proxy that does TLS interception (terminates and re-encrypts). They asked about audit log retention and key rotation too.

Olivia C: Pricing ask — 200 qps sustained. Needs a committed reserve + burst plan. @Sam P / @Matt G do we have a simple GPU sizing estimate for sales? Also they asked for 1- and 3-year term pricing.

Sam P: Quick thumb: 200 qps * avg 150 tokens/request => ~30k tokens/sec => ~2.6B tokens/day rough (this is very rough). For consistent low-latency serving I'd suggest a Dedicated reserved pool equivalent to 3-5 A100-class GPUs with nodeAutoscale for short bursts and ~20% headroom. Exact number depends on sequence length and model comfort. I'll attach a calc sheet to the runbook.

Matt G: Security bits: for Hosted we can use managed KMS; enterprise customers can plug in their KMS/HSM for Private. For SAML + proxy interception: if proxy terminates TLS we need their CA bundle to validate mutual-TLS hooks, and we need to document cert fingerprinting if they require cert pinning. We can support RSA4096 certs but it adds setup time.

Presales Bot: Runbook created -> https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/presales/bankedge-poc (checklist: IdP metadata, proxy CA bundle, network egress list, sample app). :white_check_mark:

Rachel L: Can someone drop a concise Go snippet (1 pager) showing ephemeral credential exchange and starting a streaming call with function/tool calls? Bank wants to hand to their infra team.

Sam P: Tiny Go sketch (for one-pager):
```go
// exchange ephemeral credentials
reqBody := bytes.NewBufferString(`{"client_id":"...","aud":"redwood"}`)
resp, _ := http.Post("https://auth.redwood.ai/v1/ephemeral", "application/json", reqBody)
defer resp.Body.Close()
tokenBytes, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
token := string(tokenBytes)
// start SSE stream with function calls enabled
req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=rwd-large&functions=1", nil)
req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
client := &http.Client{}
res, _ := client.Do(req)
// read SSE events from res.Body
```: This is intentionally minimal; full sample repo in the runbook.

Matt G: Network note — corporate proxies that rewrite SNI break streaming. Ask them to allowlist api.redwood.ai and sse.redwood.ai, or provide TLS passthrough. If they must intercept, we need their CA bundle and to run a validation test.

Olivia C: Security questionnaire — they sent a SOC2 + vendor security pack. Who owns answers? @Matt G can you coordinate with Eng Security and Legal. I'll kick off pricing options (1yr vs 3yr committed).

Matt G: I will loop in Eng Security. FYI: Private/on-prem option is available if required for compliance but delivery timeline is ~6-8 weeks and pricing differs significantly. Flag to AE: on-prem changes scope.

Rachel L: Great. Next steps: Matt collects IdP metadata, proxy CA and starts security Qs; Sam posts batching benchmarks + link to Go sample in the runbook; Olivia prepares Dedicated pricing sheet for 1yr/3yr. I'll follow up with BankEdge tomorrow EOD. :handshake:
